summary: INVO Fertility filed an 8-K disclosing an any-market purchase agreement with Alumni Capital LP. The issuer has the right, but not obligation, to sell up to $15M (expandable to $50M) of common stock at a discount to VWAP or last traded price (94%, 97%, or 85%). Proceeds support acquisitions of fertility clinics and general corporate purposes. This structure resembles an at-the-market offering but with committed investor mechanics. No premium, fixed price, or board recommendation is given. The registration statement on Form S-1 must be effective before sales begin. Watch for S-1 effectiveness and any clinic acquisition announcements.
